The ninja climb the 'Cliffs of Hysteria and discover that Unagami is converting players into energy cubes to build a portal into the real world.
Still in the game zone Terra Karana, Okino has to choose between helping his allies the ninja, or obeying the evil orders of his Master, Unagami.
The ninja learn that the only way to acquire the 2nd Key-tana is by winning a race in Terra Technica and have to find racing cars in unexpected ways
As the ninja prepare for the brutal Speedway Five-Billion race, Lloyd meets a race driver named Seven who may hold the key to victory.
Unagami's soldiers, the Red Visors, finally discover the secret location of Scott's garage and attack the ninja.
Our ninja barely have time to mourn the loss of their fallen ninja friends before being thrust into the madness of Terra Domina.
Back in Ninjago City, Zane and Pixal hit the mean streets to track down Milton Dyer, only to discover that things are not what they seem...
Zane, kidnapped by the Mechanic, faces Unagami while Pixal questions Milton Dyer for information on how to shut down Prime Empire.
Jay must stand alone against Unagami in the end-game, yet Unagami has a bigger battle in facing the truth about his own identity.
Unagami breaks into the real world and terrorizes Ninjago City while Jay, Zane and Pixal attempt to prevent disaster by reuniting Unagami with Dyer.

Separated from the others, Cole must find his way to the surface to alert King Vangelis of the dangerous Skull Sorcerer.

Having joined forces with the Lowly in their quest to defeat King Vangelis, Cole, Wu, and Vania have to find a way out of the bottom of the mountain.

The ninja, the Munce and the Geckles take refuge in the Geckle Strong-Cave about to confront the Skull Sorcerer and Grief-Bringer.

The battle for the fate of Shintaro Mountain concludes!

Yugi finds Grandpa's kidnapper, but is it really a kidnapping? While Yugi unravels the truth, Rebecca starts to unravel when her dragons fall prey to Leon's fervent fables. Rebecca must think of a new plan quickly or there will be no happy ending.

It's Zigfried vs. Leon for the right to challenge Yugi in the KC Grand Championship Finals... but Kaiba stops the duel!

It's a battle between Zigfried and Kaiba. Zigfried quickly gains the advantage by destroying Kaiba's monsters before he can even draw them!

Golden Castle of Stromberg is infecting the world's Duel Disks with a virus that will destroy KaibaCorp. If Yugi doesn't destroy the card, the virus program can't be stopped.
The gang goes on an exotic trip to India, but when their plane crashes in a deserted forest, their vacation turns into a dangerous game of survival.
Realizing that they've become part of a real-life version of the Capsule Monsters board game, the gang struggles to find a way out.
Reunited at last, Yugi and his friends rejoice. But their celebration is soon interrupted by a pack of man-eating wolves, a giant turtle and an angry Genie!

Grandpa translates an ancient stone tablet which directs the gang to locate the "Fortress of Fear." Now they have until sunset to find this mysterious structure or they'll be trapped in the world of Capsule Monsters forever.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Macht der Finsternis  - Teil 3

Ein Zeltdorf bietet den optimalen Platz, sodass sich Yugis Großvater ausruhen kann. Ein Mädchen führt Yugi und seine Freunde zum Dorfältesten, welcher die erste von fünf Prüfungen offenbart. Sie besteht darin, das Flüstern zum Schweigen zu bringen.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Macht der Finsternis  - Teil 4

Die zweite Aufgabe, dreht sich um Licht, Schatten und einen unzerstörbaren Stein. Aufgrund des geschwächten Zustandes von Yugi, machen sich Joey und Tristan auf den Weg und treffen in einem Tal auf ein mächtiges Glaswesen.

Durch den Verzehrs eines Apfels, verwandelt sich Yugi in den Magier des schwarzen Chaos. Jetzt kämpft er in der vierten Prüfung gegen eine Riesenmotte. Nach der Opferung eines weiteren Apfels der Verwandlung, gelangen die Freunde zu einem Portal.

Nur der weiße Drache, welcher zur Stärkung regelmäßig menschliche Seelen braucht, kann ein Dorf vor den Finsteren Fünf Drachen beschützen. Um eine Opferung zu vermeiden, treten Yugi und seine Freunde gegen die Finsteren Fünf Drachen an.
Yugi must duel a magical doppelganger of Kaiba, created from the greed and power lust Yugi wiped from Kaiba's soul.
Yugi defeats the Blue Eyes White Dragon, but there are two more waiting in the wings! Will the real Kaiba reach Yugi in time to help beat this impersonator?
Joey decides to battle Rex Raptor without his friends' help to prove that he is man enough to take care of Serenity on his own.
Joey duels valiantly, but Rex Raptor has unleashed his secret weapon: the Red Eyes Black Dragon!
Yugi's classmate Bakura, possessed by his Millennium Ring's dark powers, traps Yugi and friends in a Shadow Game where they become the cards themselves!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Ein Licht am Ende des Tunnels

Pegasus's hired duelist Panik cheats Mai of all her star chips, and Yugi vows to defeat him and win them back. But when Panik's Castle of Dark Illusions enshrouds his monsters in a black mist, how can Yugi defeat an enemy he cannot see?
Despite his astonishing disadvantage, Yugi boldly provokes Panik - "I'll finish you in three turns." Is Yugi bluffing, or does he have the advantage in this battle of wits?

Kaiba descends to the kingdom to face Pegasus. Has Kaiba changed since his battle with Yugi, or is he still the same merciless duelist? A battle between Kaiba's Blue Eyes White Dragon and Joey's Red Eyes Black Dragon holds the answers!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Arena der verlorenen Seelen, Teil 1

Bandit Keith's gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith's zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Arena der verlorenen Seelen, Teil 2

Joey's last ditch effort, his lucky Time Wizrad card, fails against Bandit Keith's zombie monsters. But as his lucky streak comes to an end, will his improving skills as a duelist and his love for his sister inspire him to victory?
Yugi and Joey band together in a team battle against the Paradox Brothers with all the Star Chips and entrance to Pegasus's castle on the line!
The Paradox Brothers summon the almighty Gate Guardian, a monster that reflects all attacks! Is Joey helping Yugi in this duel, or is his lack of experience sealing their fate for defeat?
Yugi and Joey each unleash their strongest monster, the Summoned Skull and the Red Eyes Black Dragon, but their strength pales in comparison to the tremendous power of the Gate Gurdian.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Stunde der Wahrheit, Teil 1
In order to earn the right to challenge Pegasus, Kaiba must first beat Yugi and take his Star Chips. The rematch between Yugi and Kaiba is about to begin!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Stunde der Wahrheit, Teil 2

Kaiba summons the Blue Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the strongest monster in the game fused from three Blue Eyes White Dragons! Yugi has lost all his powerful Duel Monsters, but a true duelist never gives up!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Stunde der Wahrheit, Teil 3
Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put the Blue Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life. Yugi's heart is split in two!

Having lost his star chips to Kaiba and his only opportunity to save Grandpa, Yugi is in a state of shock. Can Tea bring YUGI back to consciousness by defeating MAI for her extra star chips and teach Yugi the heart of the duelist?

Yugi and friends enter the castle to discover Kaiba ready to duel Pegssus with Mokuba's soul hanging in the balance! The power of the Millennium Eye gives Pegasus the ability to read other people's minds.
Kaiba is helpless against Pegasus's Toon World deck and mind-reading abilities. As the duel ends, Pegasus imprisons Kaiba's soul into a card, just like Grandpa and Mokuba!

Yugi vows to overthrow Pegasus for the sake of his Grandpa. Tristan leads an exploration party to uncover Pegasus's secrets. While Joey sleeps, Bandit Keith steals from him the card that permits his entry in the final battle!

Under Pegasus's glare, Yugi is distracted from his duel with Mai. After making foolish errors and allowing Mai to gain a huge advantage with her Harpie's Pet Dragon, will Yugi gather his focus or succumb to the pressure?

Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

6298bd10d88ef000073f16b7: Nesse especial descobrimos as histórias por trás da construção dos mais famosos monumentos e memorais da capital dos Estados Unidos, Washington D.C.
Veja como um mundo conectado e um esforço de guerra global levaram à pandemia mais mortal da era.
Evidências estão desafiando a história de Pearl Harbor e trazendo inimigos.
Uma eleição, reação anti-imigrantes e ativistas. Como Hitler gastou milhões para se intrometer na eleição da América.
Descubra como o F-86 Sabre passou de uma aeronave nova e não testada para o caça mais mortal de seu tempo.
Acompanhe a curta, mas impactante carreira do B-29, desde o fim da guerra no Japão até o bombardeio de aeródromos durante a Guerra da Coréia.
Veja como o lutador azarão britânico Hawker Hurricane ajudou a parar a maré do Eixo na Europa, África e Ásia.
Veja como o B-24 foi produzido em massa em um ritmo alucinante para trazer velocidade, alcance e uma enorme carga útil ao inimigo na Segunda Guerra Mundial.
De Pearl Harbor a Midway e Okinawa, veja o papel fundamental que o A6M Zero do Japão desempenhou durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial.

A NASA combate cortes orçamentários e o quase desastre da Apollo 13.
NASA se recupera do quase desastre da Apollo 13 com quatro missões lunares que mudam as viagens espaciais para sempre.

Tom e Diana são enviados para investigar um homicídio que se assemelha ao modus operandi de um serial killer que nunca foi pego por 21 anos. O primeiro suspeito é Oliver Knox, um membro dos 4400.
Dresden pega um caso pro bono depois que uma mulher que foi pedir ajuda é assassinada na sua frente. Porém, a investigação leva à magia negra e mais mortes.
Dresden enfrenta o Alto Conselho ao suspeitarem dele pelas mortes de uma aluna de faculdade e de um mafioso da região por magia negra.

664c8ba33d173b00080ef0c8: Kira et Zyro combattent dans un stadium flottant. Mais un Doji robotisé interrompt l’affrontement.
Gingka, Zyro et Kira s’unissent pour vaincre Doji, et l’AMBB peut enfin envisage l’avenir du Beyblade.
Lorsque Kenta est contraint de participer à un combat Beyblade par quatre Chasseurs de Têtes et qu'il perd.
Avant que la nouvelle amie de Gingka, Madoka n'ait pu finir de réparer sa toupie endommagée Pegasus.
Kenta a peur que Gingka quitte la ville pour trouver des adversaires à sa hauteur.
Benkei est dévasté par la perte de son mentor Kyoya qui a été obligé de suivre Doji pour payer sa dette.
Gingka refuse de combattre un voyou obsédé par les crabes appelé Tetsuya Watarigani.
Les chasseurs de tête rencontrent Hikaru Hasama qui a juré à sa mère, il y a bien longtemps, qu'elle deviendrait le meilleur blader du monde.
Benkei entraîne Kenta pour que le jeune blader puisse affronter à nouveau et vaincre Hikaru Hasama.
Doji envoie Kyoya dans le Wolf Canyon où il devra escalader une montagne et combattre des loups sauvages.
Lorsque Kyoya revient de Wolf Canyon et affronte Benkei dans un combat qui s'avère particulièrement destructeur.
Kenta porte Benkei jusqu'au B-Pit. Benkei est très mal en point.
Doji arrive pour boire à la santé de la victoire de Gingka. Mais Gingka n'a pas le temps d'apprécier ses félicitations.
Nos amis se sont introduits dans le complexe de la nébuleuse Noire. Doji les informe qu'il les attend au dernier étage.
A l'intérieur du château de la Nébuleuse noire, Gingka est face à face avec son vieil ennemi.
Kenta confronte Gingka et Gingka finit par lui raconter son passé.
Kenta a trouvé une lettre de Gingka: il doit quitter ses amis pour quelque temps, mais il ne peut pas leur dire pourquoi.
Le difficile et épuisant voyage à travers les montagnes continue.
Le groupe arrive enfin au village de Koma mais Gingka n'est plus sur place.
Gingka vient de rentrer de son expérience revigorante dans les montagnes. Gingka se rassemble avec ses amis dans le village de Koma.
En travaillant sur les toupies de nos amis, Madoka découvre une faiblesse dans le Dark Bull de Benkei.
Le monde des bladers est en émoi: l'association mondiale de beyblade organise un concours exceptionnel: un combat de survie.
Le combat de survie continue et chacun se bat de toutes ses forces pour rester en lice.
A la finale du combat de survie, les derniers participants en lice sont Kyoya, Gingka, Madoka et Yu.
Yu est récompensé d'avoir gagné le combat de survie: son voeu quel qu'il soit sera exaucé. Mais Doji arrive avec un message.
Les matchs de qualification font rage. Nos amis essaient à tout prix d'accumuler des points dans le but de participer à l'ultime bataille.
Kyoya est frustré car ses adversaires ne représentent pas de vrais défis pour lui.
Doji et Yu sont à la recherche de bladers talentueux qui participeront à l'ultime bataille.
Lors de l'inscription à un match de qualification, Kenta retrouve son vieil ami Hyoma dans la file d'attente.
Watarigani déteste Gingka par-dessus tout mais jusqu'à présent, il a été incapable de le vaincre.
Au cours d'un duel stimulant de l'Ultime Bataille, Kenta rencontre un courageux blader appelé Sora.
Gingka, Benkei, Kenta et Madoka se retrouvent tous à un tournoi beyblade où le vainqueur remportera 10.000 points.
Alors qu'une nouvelle journée de Beyblade démarre, le Blader DJ annonce quatre combats simultanés dans quatre 'stadiums' différents.
Il ne reste plus que six bladers en compétition dans un des derniers tournois de qualification.
Madoka offre à Gingka un nouveau propulseur numérique qui calcule la puissance de propulsion.
Gingka est déterminé à gagner le moindre duel pour pouvoir participer à l'Ultime Bataille et vaincre Ryuga.
Ryuga réapparaît et participe à des tournois de qualification qu'il remporte haut la main.
Tsubasa est quasiment vaincu jusqu'à ce que le Mystérieux Phoenix ne vole à son secours en mettant fin à la bataille.
Kenta arrive dans ce qui semble être une ville fantôme.
